description: Procedurally defined voxel house; not a real photograph or measured building.

geometry.walls: perimeter walls at y=1..3 with front door and window openings
geometry.roof: symmetric gable profile with eaves y=4, inner slopes y=5 and ridge y=6

caveat: Reference geometry is generated by house_reference() in house.py. Silhouettes are orthographic occupancy projections, not photorealistic camera images. Single-view depth is underdetermined.
